title: Stealth fighter panels rumored to be anti-gravity
summary: Greg Bishop tells of Stealth fighter panels rumored to be anti-gravity, about unspecified at US Air Force, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: people go in and pull panels out of it and put them in briefcases and go away. And he said the rumor was that some of those were anti-gravity just to help it fly in a different way

plain: Greg Bishop, a writer about UFO stories, tells a podcast what someone told him about the stealth fighter, a US Air Force jet built to be hard to see on radar. According to that person, people would come in, pull panels off the plane, put them in briefcases and leave, and the rumour was that some of those panels were anti-gravity parts to help it fly in a different way. If true, it would mean secret anti-gravity technology was already flying in military aircraft.
